description: Classement sonore des routes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartelie.application.i2. Classement sonore des routes en application de la loi du 31 décembre 1992, en 5 catégories en fonction de leur niveau d'émission sonore. Lorsqu'une construction est prévue dans la bande affectée par le bruit, le constructeur doit respecter des dispositions techniques aptes à assurer un confort suffisant. Cette cartographie est réalisée à titre informatif. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include Cartes interactives. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2012-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
